rights.adaptation: New graded B1 retelling written by English Tales, with English Tales translations. No modern abridgement, film script or translation was used.
rights.turkeyAssessment: Author died in 1946, more than 70 years before 2026, so the work is out of protection in Turkey and in life+70 countries.

editorialNotes: B1 target: past tense narration, sentences of at most 20 words, about 1,050 words (about 9 minutes of reading).

Retelling of the 1897 novel's main line: the bandaged stranger at the Iping inn, the burglary, the unmasking, Marvel and the books, Griffin's story told to Kemp, Kemp's note to the police, the hunt and Griffin's death, Marvel and the secret books.
Violence is kept short and without detail; Griffin's death is told in one plain sentence.
Reading sections are editorial groupings for a future chapter view; the app currently shows the story as one text.
